rows.en: Yamato: "Hey, Touya. Do you think Aurelie's all right?"
Touya: "Clovis said he'd talk to her properly...
All right, let's go see her."
Touya: "...Let's get out of here for now."
Bart: "...There's no need to be so startled..."
Bart: "If you're looking for Aurelie, I saw her
Yamato: 'She wouldn't do anything rash, would she?!
Bart: "Hmm. I don't know what's going on, but good luck..."
Touya: "You've got to be kidding... Damn it!"
Yamato: "H-Hey, Touya, are you all right?!
That was a loud bang... Touya... Tou..."
Touya: "...No, I'm not. My head's pounding..."
Aurelie: "Of course it is. You slipped and hit
your head on the floor really hard."
Touya: "Oh, right. I was startled when I saw you...!!"
Aurelie: "What's wrong? Does it still hurt?"
...Honestly. You suddenly fell over and stopped moving.
Touya: "I'm sorry... I ended up making you worry instead...
Aurelie: "Heh heh heh... Did you think I was going to kill myself?"
Touya: "Well, you weren't acting like yourself, and then the shower room...
Aurelie: "I don't have the courage to take my own life..."
Touya: "That's just running away from a painful situation.
No one's going to praise you for doing that."
Touya: "Besides, you don't have to force yourself to be strong.
You can get there a little at a time, can't you?"
Touya: "Being strong isn't the only thing that matters."
Aurelie: "Heh heh heh... I must look pretty pathetic."
It's nice to see you being honest about your feelings."
Gabon: "Hey, are you all... right? Looks like you are..."
Well, I'm glad it wasn't serious. I don't see
anything wrong, so there's probably no need for a detailed examination."
Touya: "You can tell with something that looks like a stethoscope?"
Gabon: "It's only shaped like this because I like it.
It performs better than the fixed medical equipment
It's amazing how tough his head is."
Yamato: "Hey, aren't you going after her?"
Gabon: "Then I'll be heading back too."
Yamato: "Would you rather we'd come back half an hour later?"
